authority.source: Direct researcher instructions from Abdulla dated 2026-08-08, including the later mandatory Colab GPU backend evaluation
authority.scope: Physical E1 waiting-room campaign only. The bounded G4 investigations are closed. After this reviewed backend-selection record is pushed, each new macOS CPU full cell remains conditional on its two serial ten-step smoke repeats passing every manifest gate.

backend_decision.selection_authority: Direct researcher decision rule: if the separately predeclared modern-stack G4 compatibility smoke fails, stop G4 experimentation and select the already validated macOS CPU backend.
backend_decision.campaign_execution_condition: This backend-selection change must exist remotely, then each full cell is allowed only after its corresponding two serial ten-step CPU smokes and every identity/accounting gate pass.
backend_decision.seed0_handling: Reuse the three exact validated macOS CPU physical artifacts by their retained SHA-256 identities; do not create artificial seed-0 duplication.
backend_decision.new_full_matrix: fleet seeds 1-4 by caps 0.75x, 2.5x and 40x: 12 cells
backend_decision.backend_comparison_limit: Neither G4 attempt produced evaluator output, so no scientific cross-backend comparison or measured G4 speedup exists.

seeds.task_stream_contract: Evaluator seed remains 0. Within each fleet seed, all cap points must have identical offered count, task_active array and task_type array.

cap_semantics.name: per-RSU admission/in-flight waiting-room ceiling
cap_semantics.source_resolution: int(round(rsu_cap_per_veh * padded_fleet_width)) in the pinned evaluator

legacy_semantics.limitations: No admitted identities, complete terminal outcomes or service-work conservation.

environment.sumo_note: The evaluator replays the NPZ and does not invoke SUMO. This campaign is not an exact canonical SUMO 1.27.0 reproduction.

execution.execution_hold: The runner must refuse execution unless backend_decision.status is selected and campaign_execution_allowed is true.

repeated_smoke_gate.instrumentation_comparison: exact shapes, dtypes and dtype-shape-byte SHA-256 for every array
repeated_smoke_gate.physical_validity_contract: all corrected E0 per-run checks must pass

required_assertions: offered_tasks == admitted_tasks + v2i_gate_rejected + v2i_cap_rejected + local_mqd_rejected + v2v_mqd_rejected + v2i_unavailable + v2v_unavailable
every active task has exactly one terminal outcome
V2I offered service work == admitted service work + rejected_or_unavailable service work
vehicle offered service work == admitted service work + rejected service work
all JSON numbers and instrumentation arrays are finite
counts, work, latency and queue arrays contain no unexplained negative values
deadline attainment over offered and admitted denominators remains separate
offered count, task_active and task_type are identical across caps within each fleet seed
resolved cap is exactly 1866, 6220 or 99520 as predeclared

primary.name: paired fleet-seed difference in offered-task deadline attainment
primary.denominator: all offered tasks within each fleet-seed/cap cell
primary.decision_rule: If the two-sided paired 95% Student-t confidence interval across five fleet draws excludes zero, report evidence of a directional difference within this bounded study; otherwise report inconclusive at this replication size.

secondary: penalty-inclusive latency in milliseconds per offered task
latency in milliseconds per admitted task

analysis_plan.rows: one row per fleet seed and cap
primary_outputs: two-sided 95% t confidence interval with 4 degrees of freedom

output.checksum_policy: SHA-256 every authoritative raw output; retain sizes and logical locators in checked-in evidence.
output.failure_retention: Retain failed and negative outputs, command records and logs; never delete or overwrite them.

compute_plan.backend_evidence: Established local macOS arm64 CPU runtime used for the validated E0 and seed-0 E1 physical results.
compute_plan.rejected_colab_g4_candidate: Both separately predeclared G4 attempts failed before task generation; no valid G4 evaluator timing exists.
compute_plan.concurrency_reason: One TFRT CPU device uses the ten-core host; serialize cells to preserve the validated execution contract and avoid resource contention.
compute_plan.storage_gate: available storage must remain at least twice estimated campaign output size before launch and safe before every later cell

stop_conditions: selected backend or campaign permission differs from RESEARCH_NEXT.md
evaluator, actor, trace or repository identity mismatch
repeated smokes differ scientifically or in instrumentation identity
offered count, task_active or task_type differs across cap points for the same fleet seed
offered tasks fail to reconcile with admitted plus every terminal rejection/unavailability category
V2I or vehicle service work fails conservation
NaN, infinity or an unexplained negative value occurs
load balancing, forwarding or scaling is enabled
raw output enters Git staging or an output would be overwritten
disk or 48 CPU-hour budget becomes unsafe
an unpredeclared command or configuration is used
a private artifact would be published

authorised: after this backend-selection change is pushed: the two serial ten-step macOS CPU smoke repeats required for each of the 12 new fleet-seed/cap cells
the corresponding 12 macOS CPU full cells only when each cell's repeated-smoke and all mandatory preflight gates pass
deterministic validation, analysis, documentation and permission-safe evidence publication to the TrafficTwin campaign branch
prohibited: any campaign execution before this exact manifest hash is recorded in RESEARCH_NEXT.md and the reviewed change exists remotely
any G4, other GPU, TPU or cross-backend campaign cell
E2 or any strongest-link versus JSQ, P2C or DLA comparison
legacy cells beyond retained seed-0 diagnostics
MAPPO retraining, load-augmented observations, action masking or learned dispatch
modifying or pushing vec_env or tos-data
publishing raw actor, trace, checkpoint, private paths or the unrelated PDF

known_limitations: Both G4 backend investigations failed before evaluator task generation, so no GPU scientific-comparability or speed evidence exists.
The incident trace represents one historical hour and no ordinary-traffic control is included.
The uk2030 fleet is provisional and is not a validated real-world fleet model.
The evaluator seed remains fixed at 0; fleet draw is the replication unit.
The waiting-room caps scale from padded fleet width and are not computation-power interventions.
Installed SUMO 1.27.1 differs from trace provenance SUMO 1.27.0, although SUMO is not invoked during replay.
Deadline attainment is simulated and does not confirm native physical completion or result return.
